name: Awesome FAQ – answer questions before customers ask
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Answer your visitors’ questions before they hit the contact form – beautiful, SEO-ready FAQ sections in minutes, no code required.

Awesome FAQ | Pricing | Support | Live Demos

Why Awesome FAQ?

Awesome FAQ is a lightweight, user-friendly WordPress plugin that lets you create beautiful and responsive FAQ sections using Gutenberg Blocks or shortcodes. It’s perfect for bloggers, business owners, online shops, portfolios, and anyone who needs a simple and elegant way to display frequently asked questions.

FAQ Schema (JSON-LD) is built right in. With one click, your FAQs are marked up with Google-recommended structured data – increasing the chances of rich results and “People Also Ask” snippets in search engines. No extra SEO plugin needed. An analytics dashboard also shows which questions get the most views, clicks, and engagement, so you can continuously improve your content.

The Pro version goes further with an AI-powered FAQ generator: draft product FAQs for WooCommerce using OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude Sonnet), or the native WordPress 7.0 Connectors API, and generate Q&A content with custom layout prompts right inside the Block Editor.

Free Features

  • 7 Modern FAQ Themes: Clean, professional accordion designs, free forever.
  • Fully Responsive: Looks great on all devices out of the box.
  • Two Column & Horizontal FAQ: Flexible layout choices beyond the standard accordion.
  • Gutenberg Block Support: Add and customize FAQs visually in the block editor.
  • Shortcode Support: Place FAQ sections in any page, post, or widget.
  • FAQ Schema SEO: Google-recommended JSON-LD markup for rich results.
  • AI-Powered Answer Generation: Generate answers for your FAQs.
  • Smooth Animations: Polished open/close transitions.
  • Fast and Lightweight: Optimized code with minimal footprint.
  • Easy to Use: No coding needed, and 100% ad-free.

Pro Version – AI Power & Advanced Layouts

Upgrade to Awesome FAQ Pro for advanced customization, automated layout generation, and AI power.

Pro features include:

  • More Premium FAQ Templates: Exclusive interactive, pre-designed accordion layouts.
  • Category & Filter FAQ: Organize your FAQs with filterable tabs for a cleaner presentation.
  • FAQ Search System: Real-time live search bar so users find answers instantly.
  • Multi-Column FAQ Grid: Multi-column and grid layouts to present FAQs beautifully.
  • Design & Typography Controls: Full control over backgrounds, text colors, icons, borders, margins, and typography.
  • AI-Powered Product FAQ Builder: Generate product-specific FAQs in seconds using OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude Sonnet), or the native WordPress 7.0 Connectors API.
  • WooCommerce Product FAQ Integration: Show custom FAQ sections directly on product pages, in a dedicated product tab or below the product summary.
  • Block Editor AI Builder: Auto-generate Q&A content and dynamically customize layout designs, colors, and backgrounds in Gutenberg using custom prompts.
  • Global Settings Panel: Configure AI models, API keys, and display options under WooCommerce → Settings → FAQ AI Settings.
  • Analytics Dashboard: Track user interactions, views, and clicks to optimize your questions and answers.

AI-Powered FAQ Builder

Awesome FAQ Pro includes AI-powered tools for creating FAQ content.

You can generate Q&A content directly inside the Gutenberg editor using custom prompts.

For WooCommerce products, the AI FAQ builder can generate product-specific questions and answers using supported AI providers.

Supported AI providers include:

  • OpenAI (GPT-4o)
  • Anthropic (Claude Sonnet)
  • Native WordPress 7.0 Connectors API

The AI features are designed to help you create FAQ content faster while still allowing you to review and edit the generated content before publishing.

WooCommerce Product FAQs

With Awesome FAQ Pro, you can add FAQs directly to WooCommerce product pages.

Choose where your FAQ section appears:

  • In a dedicated product tab
  • Below the product summary

You can write product FAQs manually or use the AI-powered product FAQ generator to create an initial set of questions and answers.

This is useful for:

  • Product specifications
  • Shipping questions
  • Return policies
  • Product usage
  • Compatibility questions
  • Warranty information
  • Customer support questions

FAQ Analytics

Awesome FAQ Pro includes an analytics dashboard that helps you understand how visitors interact with your FAQ content.

Track:

  • FAQ views
  • Question clicks
  • User interactions
  • Popular questions
  • Engagement

Use these insights to identify the questions visitors care about most and improve your FAQ content.

How to Use Awesome FAQ – Quick Start

Using the Gutenberg Block:

  1. Open a page or post in the block editor.
  2. Click the Add Block (+) button and search for Awesome FAQ.
  3. Add the block, then choose a theme and set colors, icons, typography, and toggle options.
  4. Add your questions and answers.
  5. Publish – your FAQ section is live!

Using a Shortcode:

  1. Go to Awesome FAQ → Add New FAQ in the dashboard.
  2. Enter your questions and answers, assign categories if needed, and click Publish.
  3. Copy the generated shortcode and paste it into any post, page, or widget.

Using WooCommerce Product FAQs (Pro):

  1. Edit a WooCommerce product and scroll to the Product FAQ — Awesome FAQ box.
  2. Check Show FAQ Section on This Product.
  3. Write FAQs manually or click Auto-Generate from Product to draft them with AI.
  4. Pick a theme, click Update, and configure global options at WooCommerce → Settings → FAQ AI Settings.

How to Create FAQs with AI

Awesome FAQ Pro can generate FAQ content using supported AI providers.

  1. Open the Gutenberg Block Editor.
  2. Add the Awesome FAQ block.
  3. Use the AI FAQ generation option.
  4. Enter your prompt or instructions.
  5. Generate questions and answers.
  6. Review and edit the generated content.
  7. Publish the FAQ.

AI-generated content should always be reviewed for accuracy and relevance before publishing.

FAQ Use Cases

Awesome FAQ can be used on many types of WordPress websites.

  • WooCommerce Product FAQs: Answer product-specific questions about features, shipping, returns, compatibility, and usage.
  • Business FAQs: Explain services, pricing, policies, and company information.
  • SaaS FAQs: Answer questions about features, plans, integrations, setup, and onboarding.
  • Support FAQs: Reduce repetitive customer questions by making common answers easier to find.
  • Documentation FAQs: Organize technical questions and answers for documentation websites.
  • Service FAQs: Explain processes, pricing, requirements, and policies.
  • Blog FAQs: Add useful question-and-answer sections to articles and tutorials.
  • Agency FAQs: Explain services, workflows, project processes, and pricing.
  • Portfolio FAQs: Answer questions about experience, services, projects, and availability.
  • Knowledge Base FAQs: Create searchable and organized collections of common questions.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Awesome FAQ”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Add the Awesome FAQ block to any page, or create FAQs under Awesome FAQ → Add New FAQ.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the Awesome FAQ plugin (faq-and-answers.zip file).
  2. In your admin area, go to Plugins → Add New and click Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file, click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Alternatively, upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory and activate it through the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
I don’t know coding. Can I use the plugin?

Yes. You don’t need any coding knowledge to use the plugin – everything is configured visually.

Does the plugin contain any ads?

No, the plugin is 100% ad-free.

How many FAQ areas can I create?

There is no limit – you can create unlimited questions, answers, and FAQ sections.

Does Awesome FAQ add FAQ schema for SEO?

Yes. FAQ Schema (JSON-LD) is built in and fully compatible with Google Rich Results, increasing your chances of FAQ rich snippets and “People Also Ask” placements – no extra SEO plugin needed.

Can I add FAQs to WooCommerce product pages?

Yes, with the Pro version you can show FAQ sections on product pages, either in a dedicated product tab or below the product summary, and even auto-generate the FAQs with AI.

Can I track how visitors use my FAQs?

Yes. The analytics dashboard shows which questions get the most views, clicks, and engagement so you can improve your content.

Which AI providers does the FAQ generator support?

The Pro AI builder supports OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude Sonnet), and the native WordPress 7.0 Connectors API, which runs a core-registered AI client with zero key setup.

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the Awesome FAQ plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.

default.title: Frequently Asked Questions
default.subTitle: Find answers to common questions about our products and services

default.question: What services do you offer?
default.answer: We offer a comprehensive range of services including web development, cloud solutions, digital marketing, and technical support. Our team of experts is dedicated to providing high-quality solutions tailored to your specific needs.

default.question: How can I contact customer support?
default.answer: You can reach our customer support team through multiple channels: email at support@example.com, phone at +1 (555) 123-4567, or through our live chat feature available 24/7 on our website.

default.question: How do I create an account?
default.answer: Creating an account is simple! Click the Sign Up button in the top right corner, fill in your details, verify your email address, and you're ready to go. The entire process takes less than 2 minutes..

default.question: How can I reset my password?
default.answer: To reset your password, click on the Forgot Password link on the login page. Enter your email address, and we'll send you a password reset link. Follow the instructions in the email to create a new password.

default.question: What payment methods do you accept?
default.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers. For enterprise customers, we also offer custom payment terms and invoicing options.

default.question: How do I update my billing information?
default.answer: You can update your billing information by logging into your account, navigating to the Billing section, and clicking on Update Payment Method. Here you can add, remove, or modify your payment details..

default.question: What are your system requirements?
default.answer: Our platform is designed to work on all modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and devices. We recommend using the latest version of your preferred browser for the best experience.

default.question: How do I integrate your API?
default.answer: We provide comprehensive API documentation and SDKs for various programming languages. You can find detailed integration guides, code examples, and API references in our Developer Portal.
